  COUNT(*) AS gene_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_genes
FROM world_cup.genomics.genes
GROUP BY biotype
ORDER BY gene_count DESC;
